name: Trigger.dev dark OG social card by trigger.dev
description: A 1200×630 dark social card that leans on a single rotated, blurred screenshot of the product's run-timeline UI for texture and credibility without competing with the message. The lockup sits top-left — a green triangle mark beside 'Trigger' in green and '.dev' in violet — while a two-line, ~72px white headline in a bold geometric sans is pinned to the bottom-left safe zone. A diagonal depth-of-field blur plus a dark gradient scrim keep the striped duration bars, blue highlight bar and status dots strictly atmospheric, so high contrast exists only where text sits.
